root_cause.text: do_task_stat() in fs/proc/array.c directly dereferences task->real_parent without holding RCU read lock, creating a race condition where the parent task can be freed by release_task() before the subsequent PID lookup, leading to a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly describes the race: CPU 0 stores task->real_parent without RCU lock, CPU 1 frees the parent via call_rcu(), then CPU 0 calls task_tgid_nr_ns(var) which takes RCU lock too late and accesses freed memory. The patch fixes this by replacing task_tgid_nr_ns(task->real_parent, ns) with task_ppid_nr_ns(task, ns), which internally handles RCU protection.
